item.title: Infections from raw milk have sickened more than 100 in Idaho
item.description: Cyclosporiasis has been getting all the headlines, but infections from raw milk have sickened more than 100 in Idaho this summer.
item.content:encoded: Cyclosporiasis has been getting all the headlines, but infections from raw milk have sickened more than 100 in Idaho this summer.
item.dc:creator: Lauren Paterson

item.title: A new vaccine could vanquish a major cause of deadly diarrheal disease
item.description: Over 1 million people a year die from diarrheal disease. Nearly half are kids under age 5. A new vaccine in trials offers great hope.
item.content:encoded:
Over 1 million people a year die from diarrheal disease. Nearly half are kids under age 5. A new vaccine in trials offers great hope.

(Image credit: Smith Collection)
item.dc:creator: Joseph Kim

item.title: Everyone's talking about hormone therapy for menopause. Should I be on it?
item.description: For years, doctors advised against hormone therapy for women in the menopausal transition. Now everyone's talking about how great it is. Is it really a wonder drug that women should all be on?
item.content:encoded: For years, doctors advised against hormone therapy for women in the menopausal transition. Now everyone's talking about how great it is. Is it really a wonder drug that women should all be on?

item.title: Kalshi and Polymarket bets on clinical trials criticized as 'ghastly'
item.description: Researchers warn betting on clinical trials could incentivize insider trading and interfere with drug development. But Kalshi and Polymarket say they provide valuable information to patients.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Supplements are a fast-growing industry, but there's little evidence on effectiveness
item.description: Supplements are a $70 billion industry that's growing fast. But there's little evidence that many supplements actually do what they promise.
item.content:encoded: Supplements are a $70 billion industry that's growing fast. But there's little evidence that many supplements actually do what they promise.

item.title: This country is the latest to hit the elusive 95/95/95 HIV target
item.description: The United Nations has set a goal for near universal HIV diagnosis and treatment for all by 2030. No country in Asia has hit the mark — until this year.

item.description: Addiction treatments are safe, effective — and rarely offered to patients. That's because many doctors and nurses still view people with alcohol or drug addiction with suspicion and hostility.

item.title: Most U.S. doctors avoid treating patients with addiction, leaving millions vulnerable
item.description: Despite a deadly public health crisis, most U.S. doctors, nurses and other health workers turn away many patients with alcohol and drug addiction without offering them science-based medications.
